title: Police Post at Institute of Mental Health to Protect Staff
what_it_is: Police Post at Institute of Mental Health to Protect Staff

sections.label: IMH staff abuse response measures
sections.summary: IMH provides panic alarms and Auxiliary Police Officers, and from January to September 2016 reported 12 abuse cases to Police, who took action against eight persons.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: IMH also provides panic alarm tags to inpatient ward staff and equips clinic consultation rooms with panic alarm buttons.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: These Auxiliary Police Officers are trained to respond to incidents involving persons with mental health conditions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: They are able to handle most incidents of abuse of IMH staff and will contact the Police to handle cases that they deem more serious.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: From January to September 2016, IMH staff reported 12 cases of physical or verbal abuse to the Police.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Police investigated these cases and prosecuted one discharged IMH former patient for unlawful stalking of an IMH staff under the Protection from Harassment Act, applied for another to be detained under the Mental Health (Care and Treatment) Act, and administered stern or conditional warnings to six more persons.

sections.label: Police reports and hospital protocols
sections.summary: Staff are advised to make Police reports at NPPs, NPCs or Police Divisions, and protocols exist between Police, MOH and restructured hospitals including IMH.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: The Member is referring to administrative referrals or making of reports, most likely after the fact, so the staff is advised to make a Police report.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: That was the role of Police Posts in hospitals in the past from the 1980s to about 2011 when MHA rationalised the resource allocation of Police Officers and these Police Posts were principally handling, as the Member mentioned, administrative tasks, such as making Police reports, the Coroners' cases, and so on.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Now, this can be made at Neighbourhood Police Posts (NPPs), Neighbourhood Police Centres (NPCs), and Police Divisions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Between the Police, the Ministry of Health (MOH) and the restructured hospitals, including IMH, there are protocols in place, and we will certainly look at the Member's concern about how we can make this more efficient and effective for the staff.
